notes.title: Procgen Maps and Infamy!
notes.notes: [p]Gday Sailors![/p][p][/p][p]We're happy to bring you the next update of Sea Of Survivors! This update includes: procedurally generated maps, location based waves, the infamy system (new game+), 19 new treasures, and a lot of quality of life improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Unfortunately, as a side effect of the new map system, [b]all progress on the old map is lost[/b].[/p][p][/p][h1]The Map[/h1][list][*][p][b]All progress on the old map is lost[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Maps are now procedurally generated based on an input seed[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy waves now vary by island, with each island having a raid wave and an area wave[/p][/*][*][p]Buried treasure islands now always give a fixed treasure, based on the map seed[/p][/*][*][p]Bottles now always give maps to the 3 closest islands[/p][/*][*][p]Added the new cartographer island, which reveals the closest undiscovered island when raided[/p][/*][*][p]Mergates now reveal all other Mergates when raided[/p][/*][/list][h1]Infamy[/h1][list][*][p]Removed the various curses from the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 19 tiers of Infamy, slowly ramping up the difficulty of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Each tier of infamy is unlocked by finishing a run on the previous tier of infamy[/p][/*][/list][h1]Treasures[/h1][list][*][p]Added 19 new treasures[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted which chests treasures are found in (the cross is now in the boss chest)[/p][/*][*][p]Some treasures can now only be found via an ambition or by raiding an island[/p][/*][*][p]Treasures will now display tickers on the side of the screen for their effects[/p][/*][*][p]Compasses now give a speed boost based on location, instead of direction[/p][/*][*][p]Capped the Feast treasures at 1 each[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the scaling of Ramstein's Spyglass[/p][/*][*][p]The "cooldown" stat has been renamed to "cooldown reduction"[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a "chest queue", so multiple chests can be opened in a single treasure screen[/p][/*][*][p]When picking up chests, the treasure screen won't open until all nearby chests are picked up[/p][/*][*][p]Ambitions triggered by placing a treasure will be added to the chest queue[/p][/*][*][p]Level up chests triggered by skipping chests will be added to the chest queue[/p][/*][/list][h1]Enemies[/h1][list][*][p]Minefish and Submarines now spawn with a more random pattern[/p][/*][*][p]The Great One now immediately teleports the player at the start of the fight[/p][/*][*][p]The aura's given off by Curseweaver boats are now limited to affecting nearby enemies[/p][/*][/list][h1]Misc[/h1][list][*][p]Upgraded to Unity 6[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the Unity splash screen[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the Main Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the Quartermaster Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the Crew Ambition UI to be more straightforward[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the performance issues caused by large amounts of pickups[/p][/*][*][p]Added the "Overkill" stack to track damage dealt to enemies past their max health[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to stop the game pausing when minimized ("run in background")[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to remove the confirmation when skipping chests ("disable skip chest confirm")[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the "Everything must go" achievement wouldn't be rewarded[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where transforming treasures could freeze the game, still on the lookout for more bugs with transforming[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We're still working on the last area, which will feature 3 more weapons, new enemies, and new treasures.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for sailing with us![/p][p]Nah Yeah Games[/p]

notes.title: Crew overhaul, a new chest, and more!
notes.notes:
This update introduces the long overdue crew system overhaul, replacing the tedious crew leveling and passives with a more interactive quest system: [b]Crew Ambitions[/b], allowing you to plan runs which satisfy your Crew, for which they'll share their personal treasures!
[h3]Crew overhaul[/h3]
[list]
[*] Crew leveling and passive skills have been replaced with 41 new Ambitions
[*] Including 12 new treasures only rewarded from Ambitions
[*] Players with trained crew will be awarded doubloons for each removed skill
[*] Ambitions are a once per run quest that gives a fixed treasure reward
[*] Crew wages are based on their satisfied ambitions
[*] Crew mates can now be retired to gain their wage in doubloons
[/list]
[h3]Boss Chest[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new chest with 6 new treasures has been added as a reward for slaying each boss
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Indicators can now be removed by clicking on them in the map
[*] Indicators can now be placed by clicking on the map
[*] Indicators placed on the map are numbered and shown in order during a run
[*] Weapon selection at the start of the run is now a drop down menu
[*] Port selection at the start of the run now opens the map
[*] All in-run pauses, such as opening chests, or raid events, are now triggered by picking up items
[*] Refreshed the Tavern and Stash menus
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Kill Count raids are now for a fixed amount of kills, scaling exponentially for each raid completed
[*] Crit Chance over 100% has a chance on hit to be added to Crit Damage, rather than guaranteeing a multicrit
[*] Lantern, Carpenters Tools, and Voodoo doll now only affect the closest weapon
[*] Empty Crate now scales with the total amount of empty slots
[*] Fish no longer count towards feast stacks before taking Chowder
[/list]
There's also various other small fixes and tweaks.

We're currently working on adding the next area to the map, with even more adventures to be had!

Thanks for sailing with us!
Nah Yeah Games.

notes.title: The Shifting Isles
notes.notes:
Ahoy Sailors!

We're dropping anchor to bring you the next Sea of Survivors update!

[h3]The Shifting Isles[/h3]
Hidden deep within the murky waters of the Shifting Isles, the Curseweavers gather, toiling in unity, weaving curse after curse on one another with singular purpose, uniting the world under a nightmarish order, by bringing forth the Great One.

In the Shifting Isles, there's many secrets to discover:
[list]
[*] 3 new weapons
[*] 3 new bosses
[*] 10 new enemies
[*] 35 new locations
[*] 21 new bounties
[*] 21 new treasures
[/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
The Shifting Isles come with a lot of other changes:
[list]
[*] The Grand Deep has been completely rearranged
[*] The Dutchman has a new moveset
[*] The barrel dropping sloops have completely new art
[*] Some Raids now require kills to complete, instead of time
[*] There's a new Raid UI for counting the seconds left or kills required
[*] Renamed preparation to charge
[*] New weapon charging UI for visualizing cooldown/charge interactions
[*] 6 new stats - Overcharge (weapon magazine size), Wisdom (xp rate), Greed (doubloon rate), Reach (pickup range), Hardness (damage reduction), and Recovery (Hp regen)
[*] Coin treasures now immediately give doubloons, instead of waiting until the end of the run
[*] Make Pegleg always give 5 Amount - [i]we've added more ways to build amount, and more ways to duplicate treasures, and we cannot make computers/enemies keep up with the old pegleg.[/i]
[*] Lightning bounces now scale with the Amount stat
[*] Removed the Bounce stat - [i]Bounce turned every projectile weapon into lightning, making them all feel the same, as well having negative impacts on weapon balance and performance, so we've made the call to cut it. [/i]
[*] Islands now have a sea foam VFX effect applied
[/list]
[h3]Whats Next?[/h3]
This update took us awhile, we had to rebuild a few systems to allow us to add all the new content, going forwards, we're going to be doing smaller more frequent updates. We're still not sure how we're going to split the next area up into smaller updates, but the next updates will come a lot quicker than this one did!

Next on our list while we figure out how to break up the next area:
[list]
[*] Polishing the in/end game menu
[*] Viewing logs from past voyages
[*] Redoing the Crew systems
[*] Polishing Shifting Isles with all feedback
[/list]
Thanks for sailing with us!

Nah Yeah Games.

notes.title: Sea of Survivors handpicked for PixElated Festival
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that Sea of Survivors has been handpicked for PixElated Festival, presented by Brave At Night!

The festival celebrates the best indie games with outstanding pixel art, and we're honored to be among the select few chosen to present their games. The event runs from July 29th to August 5th, 2024, and will be a visual feast for all pixel art enthusiasts.

Sea of Survivors and PixElated Festival will feature as a Midweek deal, alongside some other incredible indie titles.

notes.title: Map, Ports, Rerolls, and More.
notes.notes:
Ahoy Sailors!

We’re dropping anchor again to bring you the next Sea of Survivors update! This one introduces new mechanics at the voyage level and the progression level, as well as a lot of systems, quality of life, and bug fixes in preparation for the upcoming content update.

[h2]The Map[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787440/6b7dc177bb1a26479335a2af77d8ba82248eee76.png[/img]
We’ve added a live map to the pause menu, which shows locations you’ve visited, or raided, and the path your voyage has taken. The new pause menu also lets you view crew, stats, and your captains log live during the run.

[h2]Cross Doubles Everything![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787440/60fba5310475bf51e5ff82edf29adf9ff2fec693.png[/img]
The Conquerors Cross now doubles all other upgrades, including Salt, Ritual Dagger, Heart of the Kraken, not just stats anymore, all of them! This is actually just the result of a much bigger change, we had to rebuild the upgrade system to let us do a lot of cool new things for the upcoming biome. So now, the Cross doubles everything, a lot of other small interactions have improved, and we can update your stats live as you hover slots with your treasure!

[h2]Staking & Rerolls[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787440/5ff5deb628d79fdcc23a6657634ef70dec28478f.png[/img]
A lot of captains have amassed tremendous fortunes, our plan is to give you more to spend that gold on throughout your voyages, once you’ve parted with 10,000 gold upgrading your ship, you’ll unlock the ability to invest a stake in your voyages, which can only (for now) be spent re-rolling chests. Be careful however, if you sink while staking, you’ll lose all the doubloons you staked, and collected throughout that run.

[h2]Ports[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787440/0a2ed3a94e36b0523c509e559a2ea97b99436313.png[/img]
Discover various hideout locations through the Grand Deep, which you can embark from on future voyages, and dock at to escape the hordes. Embarking from a port means you start in a different location. After raiding a port, you’ll have the option to dock, ending the run early, but ensuring you don’t sink and lose your crew, stake, or treasure.

[h2]Whats next?[/h2]
The next big update will feature the Shifting Isles, a new area introducing new treasures, enemies, bosses, raids, crew skills, and mechanics. Look forward to more ways to spend your doubloons, more crazy builds, and more unique pirate adventures. We really want to make each voyage feel unique, so Sea of Survivors still has a long way to go.

Thanks for sailing with us!

Nah Yeah Games.

[h2]P.S. Patch notes:[/h2]
[h3]New Mechanics:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Start voyages from any discovered Port
[*] End voyages early upon raiding a Port
[*] ‘Curse of Avarice’ - enables embarking on a voyage with doubloons taken from the stash
[*] Re-rolls - spend doubloons to re-roll chests, the first re-roll of a voyage costs 100 gold, cost doubles each re-roll
[*] The Dutchman now spawns immediately upon finishing the Skull Ilse raid - we’re keen to see how fast people can sink the Dutchman and finish a voyage at a port
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pause menu - Added live event log
[*] Pause menu - Added live run statistics
[*] Pause menu - Added live map
[*] Live map - Shows locations visited in the past (as question marks)
[*] Live map - Shows locations raided in the past (as named locations)
[*] Live map - Shows the route taken throughout the voyage
[*] Pause menu - Added current crew summary screen
[*] Live run statistics - Show stats using “MMO” numbers - 10k, 10m, 10b
[*] Controls - On keyboard, bound the ‘M’ key to open the map
[*] Treasure screen - Links and Stats now update live while hovering slots with treasures
[*] Treasure screen - Current gold counter added
[*] Treasure screen - A ReRoll button (once unlocked)
[*] Treasure screen - All other pause screens are viewable from the Treasure screen
[*] Quartermaster screen - Complete new look
[*] Quartermaster screen - Weapons on the Quartermaster screen now have a tooltip on hover
[*] Quartermaster screen - New staking input, for specifying how many doubloons to embark with (once unlocked)
[*] Quartermaster screen - A “redo stake” button, for reapplying the last non-zero stake
[*] Quartermaster screen - New port input, for choosing which discovered port to being your run at (once discovered)
[*] Upgrade system - Cross now doubles everything
[*] Upgrade system - Multiplicative effects always stack before being applied
[*] Shipwright - Adjusted upgrade prices
[*] Shipwright - Adjusted upgrade order
[*] Tooltips - Now shrink to fit their text, and align better with various elements
[*] Added a quick fog screen transition between most scenes
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Grand Deep Cartographer bounty wouldn’t claim because of the Curseweavers Conjuring Camp
[*] Fixed a bug where the Floating Fortress bounty wouldn’t claim
[*] Fixed a bug which allowed duplicating treasures from a chest
[*] Fixed a bug where Steam Deck would have intermittent issues with saving for some players.
[*] Updated the game engine - which should resolve some crashes related to graphics drivers and Direct X
[*] Fixed a bug where menus would scale improperly on some resolutions
[*] Reworded the ‘Don’t scratch the paint bounty’ - it’s claimed by finishing a voyage without taking a single hit
[*] Fixed a bug where Ritual Dagger and Flintlock Dagger were applied in different orders depending on their position - now multiplicative effects always stack before being applied
[*] Fixed a bug where the explosion VFX on the barrels dropped by the fast boat weren’t aligned with barrels
[*] Fixed various controller cursor desync bugs
[*] Fixed some memory leaks related to particle effects
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update: New Weapon + QoL
notes.notes:
Hey Sailors!

We've just hauled a new update onto Steam.

We've gotten lots of feedback on Steam, worried that we've abandoned Sea of Survivors: We haven't! We're a small team of 3 and this is our first game, so we've had some growing pains, but we've been hard at work on the systems of Sea of Survivors, and the next area, featuring new enemies, new weapons, new items, and new islands. We're going to ship more smaller updates to make it more obvious we're still hard at work!

The highlight of today's update is a [b]new weapon[/b] to celebrate Pirates vs Ninjas! [b]The Shuriken[/b]! For now it starts unlocked, but we'll change that once when we introduce the new area.

This is the full list of changes:

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*] New weapon - Shuriken 
[*] Reworked the Blunderbus Ambushers
[*] Gave the Cannonback Tortuga a tether and a Dash attack!
[/list]

[h3]System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Picking up a map in a bottle now lets the player pick the destination type out of 3 options
[*] The end of run captains log now features a list of events that occurred in the run, with split times
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Crewmates are now sorted by Xp in the Tavern
[*] Crewmate skill filters are now in alphabetical order in the Tavern
[*] Anchors are now considered a Melee weapon for the sake of bounties
[*] Added a feedback button to the pause menu
[*] Added a new curse for disabling map pickups
[*] Killing the Dutchman now collects all dropped coins
[*] Blazebeards Wake kills now count as fire kills for the sake of bounties
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a treasure and the 50% xp for skipping could be taken in the upgrade screen
[*] Health bar width is now capped to prevent pushing the timer off the screen
[/list]

Please give it a shot and let us know what you think,
Happy Sailing!

notes.title: Bullet Heaven Fest
notes.notes:

notes.title: Sea of Survivors sails into Early Access!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ahoy Pirates![/h1]

Happy to announce Sea of Survivors has entered Early Access! We've been building and playtesting for a long time now, and we're finally ready to open it up to the world.
[h2]Early Access introduces:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 9 new Islands to find
[*] 12 new bounties
[*] A new secret boss
[/list]
[h2]Will your progress from the Demo carry over?[/h2]
Your progress from the demo will continue over as long as:
[list]
[*] You're playing on the same PC you played the demo on, [b]OR[/b]
[*] You play on the same PC you played the demo on once, before you start playing on the new PC.
[/list]
[h2]What are we doing next?[/h2]
[list]
[*] We'll be watching the Steam Community Hub and Sea of Survivors [url=https://discord.gg/DhxU4jFHsW]Discord[/url] closely for any reported issues.
[*] We'll be localizing the game into a few languages.
[*] We'll be enabling all the bounties as steam achievements.
[*] We'll be routinely shipping new content to find on your voyages.
[/list]
Join the [url=https://discord.gg/DhxU4jFHsW]Discord[/url] and help shape the future of Sea of Survivors with us!

Smooth Sailing,
Nah Yeah Games.

notes.title: The Crew System & EA Release Date
notes.notes:
[b]Ahoy Pirates![/b]

We’ve made it! Sea of Survivors is ready for Early Access! On the [b]18th of October 2023[/b], Sea of Survivors will be available. Get ready to assemble your crew and set sail on a pirate adventure like never before. 

We want to take this opportunity to thank you all for your unwavering support so far. If you haven’t already, you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2347940/Sea_of_Survivors/]Wishlist [/url] Sea of Survivors on Steam - it helps us tremendously! If you’d like to join the conversation, we also have an amazing crew of people on Discord - https://discord.gg/d3AvRGP3P3 
[h2]Crew[/h2]
[b]You can start building your crew right now in the demo, and your pirates will transfer over on release![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787440/c67d11287687ae6be34295e14ac6fd034948ddac.gif[/img]

[b]Recruit and Manage Your Own Crew of Pirates:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Hire the best crew for the job and sail with enhanced abilities, but beware, sink your ship and members of your crew will be lost at sea[/b]
[*] [b]Each pirate you meet has a combination of useful skills as well as their own unique name and appearance[/b]
[*] [b]With each journey, your crew members gain experience and develop useful skills.[/b]
[*] [b]As you explore the map you’ll get the chance to recruit shipwrecked pirates to add them to your roster… And, with a bit of luck, you’ll find some of your lost crewmates.[/b]
[/list]
[h2]What’s on the Horizon?[/h2]
We're getting a bunch more cool stuff ready for early access. Here's a list:
[h3]New Treasures, Curses and Weapons:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Personalize your ship with new weapons and upgrades to create your playstyle, from rapid-fire harpoons to devastating lightning strikes.[/b]
[*] [b]Collect rare treasures to enhance your vessel's firepower, resilience and versatility.[/b]
[*] [b]Unlock mysterious curses for a greater challenge and increased rewards.[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Explore the Mysterious Archipelago:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Uncover the mysteries of the archipelago and the eerie horrors of the deep that lurk below the surface.[/b]
[*] [b]Test your strategy and navigational prowess in a new environment that completely changes the game.[/b]
[*] [b]Risk it all against powerful new bosses in our toughest challenge yet.[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Unlockable Content, Bounties and Steam Achievements[/h3]

notes.title: DEMO Update
notes.notes:
Ahoy Pirates!

Thanks to everyone that played the demo! The feedback so far has been great.

We've just pushed the first update to the demo, the big changes:
- Treasures no longer stack (except for weapons)
- Treasures that used to stack, now get stronger for each surrounding treasure instead
- Tooltips and Keywords for the upgrade system!
- You can now click on a just placed treasure to undo the placement
- You can now right click after placing a treasure to undo the placement
- Doubled the size of the coins

We've also fixed a bunch of other minor annoyances.

Fair Seas,
The Nah Yeah Team

notes.title: FREE DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
Ahoy Pirates!

We proudly announce that the Sea of Survivors demo is officially live!

Embark on the high seas and attempt to survive against a faction of bounty hunters as they chase you to the edge of the known world. Hunt down merchant ships and discover powerful treasures and mysterious curses that will help you on your journey. 

The demo includes a range of weapons and cursed treasures that let you create a unique build with each run, the shipwright that allows you to spend your plunder and permanently upgrade your ship after every voyage, and a variety of enemies each with unique mechanics and challenges.

If you can prove yourself a master of the seas you will have the opportunity to face the Kraken. Can you defeat her? Or will you find yourself in the belly of the beast?

Don’t forget to follow and wishlist Sea of Survivors to stay up to date. You can also join the Discord crew and get involved with the community. https://discord.gg/d3AvRGP3P3
